| [0023](0023-bench-workflow-gates-on-compilation-only.md) | Gate the bench workflow on compilation, never on measurements | Accepted | 2026-08-10 | bench.yml's build steps gate; every measurement, diff, and comment step is continue-on-error, and comment steps are skipped outright on fork PRs. |
| [0024](0024-the-noise-gate-refuses-on-absent-evidence.md) | Make the bench noise gate refuse to certify when it has no variance data | Accepted | 2026-08-10 | all_pass() requires a non-empty cell set, --runs below 2 is rejected at parse time, and a cell with fewer than two distinct runs fails on its own. |
